stop_rules: Stop before credential access or any call unless Jimmy approves this exact roster, routes, ceilings, expiry, and NTE in writing.
Stop if pass one and the blinded repeat are not both frozen before pilot-output exposure.
Stop if cue custody is not verified before any cue-contrast-eligible run.
Stop if any exact model ID, official price, context limit, output limit, provider route, or required parameter cannot be reverified at preflight.
Stop after three harmless smoke calls per model unless all identity, no-fallback, decoding, usage, and receipt checks pass.
Stop a route before its first bank call if its smoke cost exceeds its recorded route smoke ceiling.
Stop the full pilot when cumulative provider-reported spend reaches 3.60 USD; reserve the remaining 0.40 USD for delayed usage reconciliation and do not dispatch another call.
Treat unknown delivery status as terminal evidence; do not retry automatically.
Never exceed 1356 total calls or 4.00 USD under this proposal.
remaining_preflight_unknowns: Mistral Small 4 maximum output-token limit was not stated on the cited official model card and must be verified before authorization.
Account-specific rate limits, regional availability, tax treatment, and billing rounding must be verified without changing the NTE.
Provider support for the exact registered decoding parameters and response contracts must pass the harmless smoke.
